dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two high-contrast white wing bars are visible; the upper bar is thicker and more diffused, while the lower bar is a sharp, thin linear band across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent and sharp white edges on folded secondary flight feathers create a series of high-contrast diagonal lines against the dark grey feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A high-contrast black patch is visible across the crown and nape with a rounded posterior boundary.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct, linear color transition separates the black plumage of the nape from the olive-grey plumage of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, bright white auricular patch is highly visible, contrasting sharply with the dark crown and throat area.
